data_gaps.need: Visser 2023 Table 4 read directly for the adrenal: whether any hormone or marker with imaging gives an adrenal cortical code, and whether the adrenocorticotropic hormone route (8158/3) applies to an adrenal mass
data_gaps.why: This part's file list does not include Visser 2023; the evidence gate's marker option at the adrenal cortex rests on the controller's summary. Recommendation is no marker option.

data_gaps.need: Whether cytology (fine-needle aspiration) alone may name adrenal cortical carcinoma
data_gaps.why: Neither source discusses cytology of adrenal cortical tumours; the Wieneke and Weiss criteria need a resection (weight, size, capsular and vascular invasion). The ac_cytology option coding 8370/3 at basis 5 rests on the cytopathologist's stated diagnosis only.
